title: Ayesa's size alone rules it out at this stage
content:
Ayesa, including Ibermatica, is marked do-not-pitch, and the reason recorded is size alone: 13,200 people. It was previously ranked first in Spain.

That is a sequencing judgement rather than a verdict on posture or stack, neither of which was researched. A firm at that scale allocates pilots to practices and evaluates suppliers through procurement, which is the wrong process for shaping something that does not yet have a reference implementation.

The entry is worth keeping precisely because its exclusion is reversible: what rules it out now is a stage in the go-to-market, not a property of the firm.
